Open the balance profile list. Switching profiles never removes installed upgrades.

To configure upgrade limits or balance rules independently, first switch to Custom and save, then edit the individual settings. Switching to Custom inherits the previously effective preset values.

Productivity and speed tiers are mutually exclusive. Centrifuge productivity upgrades add parallel processing only. Apiaries obey bee behavior and weather-tolerance genes. Default Productive Bees and centrifuge stack limits are 4 and 8. Closer to the original feel of Mekanism and Productive Bees, but still far from the true power of the Myriad Creations Bee.

Productivity and speed tiers can coexist. Centrifuge productivity upgrades increase both output and parallel processing. Apiaries ignore bee behavior and weather-tolerance genes, and multi-flower bees produce from every distinct valid feeder source each cycle. Default Productive Bees and centrifuge stack limits are 8 and 16. Blessed by the Myriad Creations Bee, the Productive Bees upgrades reclaim part of their rightful power.

designer.tutorial.select.title: 1 · Select or create a bee
designer.tutorial.select.body: Search the library by localized name or ID. Click a bee to edit it; its menu offers copy, delete and export. In selection mode, clicking a card only selects it, without opening an editor or creating a draft.
designer.tutorial.edit.title: 2 · Appearance and traits
designer.tutorial.edit.body: Edit appearance, traits, acquisition and output. Small windows keep common pages visible and offer More for the rest; secondary groups can collapse. Numeric ranges and errors appear beside their controls. Ctrl+Z undoes; Ctrl+S saves a draft.
designer.tutorial.outputs.title: 3 · Acquisition and production
designer.tutorial.outputs.body: Acquisition recipes determine how to obtain a bee. Production can output directly from a hive or use combs followed by centrifuging. Dragging an item copies settings without consuming inventory. Right-click or Delete removes an output; drag its heading or use arrows to reorder.
designer.tutorial.review.title: 4 · Check and apply
designer.tutorial.review.body: The publish page has a graphical overview with inline edits and links to the relevant section. Run Check first; click a problem to locate and expand its field. Applying reloads data and may briefly pause the game. Dedicated servers require Creative mode and OP permission.
designer.tutorial.portable.title: 5 · Export and attribution
designer.tutorial.portable.body: Select multiple bees in the library or drafts to export. Portable collections transfer projects between modpacks; datapacks and KubeJS bundles support distribution. Enter the source modpack, retain attribution and release links, and follow licenses. Missing mod content is not bundled.
designer.tutorial.files.title: 6 · Drafts and file locations
designer.tutorial.files.body: Settings → File locations shows full paths with copy and open-folder actions. Drafts belong to this game instance; collections are in bee-designer/collections. Autosave starts after real edits. Deleted projects can be recovered in the recycle bin; world changes still require Apply.

productivebeesgenesis.configuration.adva: Virtual ticks buffered per machine. Default: 8192; maximum: 32768. Does not raise the per-tick processing budget.

designer.history_loading: Loading published revisions for this world…
designer.history_retry: Could not load revisions. Click Refresh to retry.
designer.history_empty: No published revisions in this world. Apply to current world creates one; drafts and local exports do not.
designer.kubejs_export_help: Includes bee definitions in kubejs/data, translations in kubejs/assets, and recipes in server_scripts. Extract into the pack root; install either this bundle or the datapack export for the same bee.
designer.error.machine_migration_field: Cannot convert field “%s” without data loss. The original recipe is retained. Choose a machine from the same host or adjust incompatible fields.
designer.error.setting: Invalid setting for “%s”. Check the input.
designer.error.output_range: Minimum output must not exceed maximum output.
designer.error.export_budget: Export exceeds the file or size budget.
designer.production_nodes_help: Configure items, fluids and resources together. A flow generates matching recipes. Choose direct output or comb processing, then add outputs.
designer.individual_recipes_help: Each recipe acts independently. Edit existing and advanced recipes by their original ID; each entry describes its host and input.
designer.flow_pb_direct: PB hive cycle → direct item outputs from this recipe; no comb processing step.
designer.flow_pb_centrifuge: PB centrifuging: consumes the matching material below to produce these items and fluid.
designer.flow_resource_direct: Direct production: a hive that supports extended resources produces these outputs without centrifuging. Existing PB item routes remain separate.
designer.flow_resource_centrifuge: Resource centrifuging: a Genesis resource centrifuge host processes the matching comb to produce resources. Include PB outputs also combines matching PB centrifuge results.
designer.settings_theme_help: Edit separate dark and light palettes, or drop a theme JSON here. Apply colors, then save settings to keep your preferences.
designer.settings_interaction_help: These settings affect this editor only. Drafts and themes are stored in your local bee-designer folder; server config and game GUI scale are unchanged.
designer.shortcut.search: Ctrl+F: search the current catalog or fields.
designer.shortcut.save: Ctrl+S: save the current bee as a local draft.
designer.shortcut.undo: Ctrl+Z: undo. Biome selections and JSON text have their own undo history.
designer.shortcut.theme: F2: switch between dark and light themes.
designer.shortcut.layout: Ctrl+0: reset window position and size.
designer.shortcut.pages: PageUp/PageDown: scroll forms. Middle-click a scrollable area, then move up or down to control speed. Return near the starting point to pause; click again or press Esc to stop.
designer.shortcut.selection: Enter: select the highlighted entry. Esc: dismiss a popup or return.
designer.shortcut.drag: Drag the title bar to move; drag an edge to resize. Inventory and JEI drags copy declarations.
designer.shortcut.number: Use +/- to change numbers. Hold Shift for steps of 0.1.
designer.installation.creative: The BeeBee Support Handbook is usable only in Creative mode.
designer.installation.permission: Dedicated servers: applying to the world requires OP level 2 or above. Creative non-OP players may edit and export locally.
designer.installation.apply: An OP validates and applies from Publish. Bee definitions and recipes are written to the current server world and reloaded.
designer.installation.datapack: Manual setup: give the exported datapack ZIP to the server administrator. Put it in the active world's datapacks folder, then run /reload.
designer.installation.names: Names: each player installs the exported name resource pack on their client. A server datapack alone does not install client translations.
designer.installation.kubejs: KubeJS bundle: extract into the server root. kubejs/data and server_scripts provide bees and recipes; distribute kubejs/assets to each client.
designer.installation.restart: Restart server and clients for the first KubeJS bundle install. Required mods and machine definitions must be present. Avoid duplicate exports for the same bee.
designer.drag_accept: Release to copy this ingredient. Inventory items are not consumed.
designer.drag_reject: This field does not accept this ingredient type. Existing data is retained.
designer.material_nest_help: Productive Bees nest/hive, listed first for nest spawning.
designer.status.drag_no_target: No compatible ingredient target. Items and configuration are unchanged.
designer.status.preferences_reset: Defaults restored. Save to keep them.
designer.status.theme_applied: Palette applied. Save settings to keep it.
designer.error.creative_only: This handbook can only be used in Creative mode.
designer.error.settings_file: Cannot read theme/settings: use a bounded regular JSON file.
designer.error.theme_field: Invalid or unsupported theme field: %s. The existing palette is retained.
designer.error.theme_name: Theme names must contain 1–64 characters and no control characters.
designer.error.preference_field: Invalid setting: %s. Existing settings are retained.
designer.error.preferences: Invalid editor settings version or option. The original file is retained.

designer.error.json_syntax: Invalid JSON syntax. Check quotes, commas and brackets.
designer.theme.field.name: Theme name
designer.error.settings_json: Invalid theme/settings JSON. Check quotes, commas and brackets. The original file is retained.
designer.error.field_reference: %s references an unknown or unavailable resource: %s.
designer.location_missing: This issue belongs to the advanced declaration. Open its JSON to inspect it.
designer.model_help: Choose an existing PB shape; the preview updates immediately. Models without tint layers receive PB's matching texture automatically; existing custom textures are retained. Special models require GeckoLib. Shape does not select solitary or harvesting AI.
designer.model_texture_help: Special models use PB's matching texture. Standard models return to PB's default tinted texture. Custom textures are replaced only when you press this button.
designer.option.bonemeal: Apply bonemeal to the visited crop
designer.option.force_grow_crop: Grow the visited crop by one stage
designer.option.name: Sort by name
designer.overview_help: Edit appearance, traits and recipes directly here. Each section's Edit button opens its full editor. Apply and export from Checks and export.
designer.overview_breeding_help: PB breeding combines two parents into an offspring. Industrial breeders that read PB breeding recipes can use this route too.
designer.overview_spawn_help: This route declares nest spawning ingredients and biome conditions, handled by PB's nest spawning system.
designer.overview_fishing_help: This route uses PB's fishing acquisition system, subject to biome and chance conditions.
designer.overview_conditional: This recipe has load conditions and is enabled only when they are satisfied.
designer.overview_disabled: This recipe is marked disabled and will not be registered on apply.
designer.any_biome: Any biome allowed by the upstream system
designer.pending_drafts_help: Highlighted bees have local drafts that have not been applied and are listed first. Click to continue editing the draft.
designer.field_help.size: Controls model size. Must be greater than 0 and at most 100; the preview fits it to the visible area.
designer.field_help.attack: Declared attack damage accepts 0–2147483647, matching PB's BeeBee declaration. Actual damage still depends on Minecraft attack attributes, special entity code and other mods.
designer.field_help.speed: Sets declared bee movement speed. Must be greater than 0 and at most 100. PB pathfinding and behavior also affect movement.
designer.field_help.renderer: PB renderer name. Standard model selection writes this field; with GeckoLib it normally also selects the default geo model path.
designer.field_help.model: Full GeckoLib model resource path, such as productivebees:geo/entity/beebee.geo.json. The resource must be installed.
designer.field_help.animation: GeckoLib animation resource path. Omit it to use PB's default bee animation; changing it does not add AI.
designer.field_help.beeTexture: Texture resource prefix without .png. PB adds angry / nectar suffixes; the corresponding textures must exist.
designer.field_help.description: Description translation key used in tooltips. The client language files must supply the key.
designer.field_help.renderTransform: PB native models support none and flipped; flipped rotates the model by 180°. Gecko models use their resource definitions.
designer.field_help.translucent: Uses translucent model rendering. The result depends on the model and texture alpha channel.
designer.field_help.nestingPreference: Block tag ID for wild nesting preferences, such as productivebees:solitary_overworld_nests. This enables the configurable bee's wild nesting preference, without replacing its AI with SolitaryBee.
designer.field_help.flowerType: PB flower lookup mode, blocks by default. entity_types uses an entity type tag. It must match the declared flower source and the target types supported by PB.
designer.field_help.postPollination: Extra processing after pollination: encase a target mob, apply bonemeal, advance a crop by one stage, or handle suspicious block archaeology loot. Runs only for a suitable target and PB conditions.
designer.field_help.particleType: Nectar particle motion: drip, pop, lava, portal or rising. The particle color field sets its color.
designer.field_help.selfheal: Enables PB configurable bees' self healing; timing and amount are controlled by PB.
designer.field_help.withered: Attacks use PB's Wither effect. PB chooses Wither before Hunger or Blindness.
designer.field_help.munchies: Attacks use PB's Hunger effect. Wither, Hunger and Blindness follow PB's priority order.
designer.field_help.blinding: Attacks use PB's Blindness effect, following PB's priority when other attack effects are enabled.
designer.field_help.irradiated: Enables PB's irradiation trait flag, read by its behavior and integrations. It does not change the entity type.
designer.field_help.draconic: Enables PB's draconic trait for its dragon related interactions.
designer.field_help.slimy: Enables PB's slimy trait, read by the upstream behavior.
designer.field_help.teleporting: Enables PB's teleporting trait; actual teleport conditions are controlled by PB.
designer.field_help.redstoned: Enables PB's redstone trait for upstream interactions.
designer.field_help.stringy: Enables PB's stringy trait, read by upstream behavior.
designer.field_help.stingless: Stingless trait, affecting PB's attack and stinging behavior.
designer.field_help.selfbreed: Allows self breeding under PB rules. Cross species parents and offspring require a separate breeding recipe.
designer.field_help.parent_death: Chance for parents to die after breeding. 0 means no recipe induced death; 1 means certain death.
designer.field_help.processing_time: Ticks needed for centrifuging. 20 ticks normally equal one second; upgrades can change actual speed.
designer.field_help.include_pb_outputs: Whether to include PB's original outputs alongside the extended resource centrifuge outputs.
designer.field_help.conditions: Load conditions decide whether a bee or recipe is registered, such as requiring an installed mod. They are separate from production chance.
designer.field_help.machine_processing_t: Ticks required for this machine recipe. MI / MBD2 use duration; MMR uses time.
designer.field_help.machine_eu: EU consumed per tick by an MI recipe. MMR has no corresponding EU field; only a valid zero cost can migrate without loss.
designer.field_help.machine_priority: Machine recipe matching priority, interpreted by the host mod.
designer.close_page_edits_help: Keep this page's changes before continuing to close, or discard them. Return to editing keeps your input; a failed save also stays on this page.
designer.model_missing: The model resource is not installed. Use advanced fields to enter an installed resource path.
designer.field_help.bee_model: Uses PB renderers and installed Gecko models. Special shapes do not grant solitary or farmer AI.
designer.field_help.createComb: Creates a comb item for this bee. Turning it off skips automatic comb creation; centrifuge routes need a suitable input source.
designer.error.preview_resource: Preview resource is missing: %s. Choose an installed model / texture. Your edits are retained.
designer.error.preview_texture: Model %s has no usable tint layers. Use its matching texture.
designer.recovered_json_help: Unfinished input has been restored from the autosaved draft. Correct it and press Done; the world is unchanged.
designer.error.recovery_target: The recovery location in this draft has changed. The original draft file is retained.
designer.resolve_recovery_before_apply: Confirm or discard the recovered pending edits before applying to the world.
designer.recovery_pending_help: This draft has unconfirmed edits. Resume them or explicitly discard the pending input. Confirmed settings are retained.
designer.discard_recovery_help: Discard all pending recovery input in this draft? Confirmed bee settings and world data are retained.
designer.select_bee_first: Select a bee from the catalog, or create one, before editing appearance, attributes, acquisition and production.
designer.catalog_scroll_help: Drag to browse the catalog. The wheel scrolls the continuous list and entries load as they approach the visible area.
designer.browser_project_help: Choose a drive or folder, then select a JSON project or ZIP author bundle to fill the import path. This browser only reads local files.
designer.browser_machine_help: Select a JSON, JS or ZIP machine recipe source. Import still checks the original data and the host's supported capabilities.
designer.browser_empty: No supported import files in this folder.
designer.browser_limit: This directory exceeds the browsing budget, so only part is shown. Open a more specific folder or enter the full import path.
designer.error.browser_path: Invalid file path. Returned to the current game directory.
designer.error.browser_read: Cannot read folder: %s. Open its parent or choose another drive.
designer.jei_unavailable: JEI is not available. The editor's material picker and recipe overview remain available.
designer.jei_recipe_missing: This recipe is not registered in JEI yet. Apply it to the world before viewing. Your draft is preserved.
designer.jei_draft_help: This draft is not registered in JEI yet. Showing existing recipes for its output.
designer.reload_warning: Applying reloads world resources and may briefly pause a large modpack. Wait for completion; other players on the server may also be affected.
designer.special_behavior_help: These options use PB configurable bee behaviors. Nest preferences and appearance do not add SolitaryBee or FarmerBee AI. Special processing requires compatible flowers and upstream conditions.
designer.error.flower_entity_tag: Entity flowers require an existing entity type tag, without a block tag or ! prefix: %s
designer.myriad_random_production: Myriad still produces combs and comb blocks from its existing random pool. Appearance, models and traits do not replace that production route.
designer.field_help.motion_amount: Page travel distance from 0 to 24 pixels. Zero preserves color and switch feedback while disabling spatial motion.
designer.field_help.colorCycle: Cycles colors on supported PB renderers; appearance only.

designer.error.definition_missing: No editable JSON definition was found for active bee %s. It may be registered by a script or a separate entity; check its source.

designer.error.recipe_limit: A bee project supports up to 64 recipes. Existing contents are preserved; reduce the project's scope.

designer.catalog_guide: Select a bee to start editing. Highlighted cards are unapplied drafts and appear first.
designer.world_default_time: Currently %s ticks (%s seconds), following the PB world configuration.
designer.error.bee_catalog_timeout: The bee catalog did not respond. Click Refresh to retry; loaded entries and your drafts are retained.
designer.recycle_delete_help: Permanently delete the local archived draft %s? It cannot be restored from the editor. The bee, items and resources already in your world are unaffected.
designer.recycle_discard_help: Discard the local pending deletion or recycle cleanup for %s? This removes its draft and closes the current edit. Apply is not run, so the world keeps its current state.
designer.recycle_purge_impact: This bee is already disabled in the world. Clearing its recycle record removes its restoration entry after applying; the bee stays disabled.
designer.recycle_purge_assets: Existing bee items, combs in chests or AE2, and paid production remain protected. The editor retains the identity and processing recipes they need. This operation does not remove inventory items or delete world entities.
designer.recycle_purge_pending: Recycle cleanup is staged. Apply it to the world to remove this restoration entry; you can discard the pending change from the recycle bin before applying.
designer.recycle_purge_apply_help: Apply the recycle cleanup now? This removes the restoration entry and keeps the bee disabled. Existing items and processing recipes remain available.
designer.error.recycle_not_restorable: This recycle record cannot be restored or cleared again. Refresh the recycle bin; existing world data is retained.
designer.error.recycle_changed: The file changed or is no longer available. Refresh the recycle bin and confirm again; no file was deleted.
designer.status.recycle_purge_staged: Recycle cleanup saved as a draft. Apply it to the world to take effect.
designer.output_drag_help: Drag this output to another output in the same list. Its amounts, chance and components move together. Release outside a target or press Esc to cancel.
designer.output_actions_help: Click an item to replace it. Right-click or press Delete on its focused item to remove the output. Drag the item or its handle to reorder, or use the up/down buttons.
designer.status.output_moved: Output order updated; the complete output record was retained.
designer.status.output_removed: Output removed from the current edit. Apply your changes to update the world.
designer.status.output_no_target: Drag cancelled; the output and its order are unchanged.
designer.error.file_folder: This folder uses a linked path and cannot be opened by the editor. Copy the displayed path to open it yourself.
designer.error.file_folder_missing: This folder has not been created yet. Export or apply first, then open it again.
designer.files_instance_help: These are the actual folders for this game instance. A launcher may keep each modpack in a separate directory; use the full paths shown here.
designer.files_workspace_help: Local drafts, exports and settings are stored here. Personal settings are in preferences.json.
designer.files_drafts_help: One JSON per bee: <namespace>/<bee>.json. Browsing a bee does not create a draft; editing or manually saving does.
designer.files_recycle_help: Archived draft JSON files. Permanently deleting an entry removes its local file.
designer.files_datapack_help: Local Export saves a datapack ZIP and a separate -names.zip here. Install the datapack in the target world and the names pack on clients.
designer.files_kubejs_help: The ZIP contains a kubejs folder. Extract it into the modpack's game directory and retain its data, assets and server_scripts.
designer.files_machines_help: Machine recipes are exported as .js with a matching .project.json. Keep the project JSON if you want to edit it again.
designer.files_themes_help: Custom themes exported from editor settings are stored as theme-<UUID>.json.
designer.files_sources_help: Original machine JSON or scripts retained during import. These are reference copies; use the export folders when packaging your modpack.
designer.files_recent_export_help: Open the folder containing the last export made in this session.
designer.files_world_help: The following folders belong to the current singleplayer world. Applying writes to this world; local exports remain in the editor workspace.
designer.files_remote_help: On a dedicated server, world exports and applied datapacks are stored on the server computer. Ask its administrator to retrieve them. Use Local Export or KubeJS Export to get files on your own computer.
designer.files_world_exports_help: The world Export action saves datapack and name-pack ZIPs here.
designer.files_world_datapacks_help: Datapacks installed by Apply are stored here. Retrieve the latest export when packaging a modpack.
designer.files_world_history_help: World revision history, exports and recovery records. Keep this folder with the world; use the editor's history tools for restoration.
designer.files_export_choice_help: Local Export and KubeJS Export save files on your computer. World Export saves on the server. File Locations shows the exact folders and lets you open or copy their paths.
designer.status.exported_server: Saved on the server: %s. Use Local Export to get a copy on this computer.
designer.recycle_purge_complete: The recycle record has been cleared from the world. Its restoration entry is removed; the bee stays disabled, and existing items and processing recipes remain protected.
designer.myriad_additional_recipes_help: Create independent crafting, breeding, conversion or machine recipes. Validate and Apply to activate; built-in routes below retain their configuration.
designer.error.myriad_recipe_scope: This Myriad project edits acquisition and machine recipes. Use Myriad settings for appearance, attributes and random outputs.
designer.error.reload_incomplete: World resources are reloading or the last reload failed. Read again after a successful reload.
designer.bottler_help: The PB Bottler consumes an item and fluid and outputs an egg retaining the full bee identity.
designer.filter_help.DISABLED: Allow all valid conversion targets. The retained list is inactive.
designer.filter_help.BLACKLIST: Listed bees are excluded from random conversion.
designer.filter_help.WHITELIST: Only valid listed bees can be selected; an empty list allows no targets.
designer.filter_empty: The list is empty. Use Add bees or import from the actions menu.
designer.filter_reset_help: Clear the local list and disable filtering. Save to change the world.
designer.filter_reload_help: Loading server settings replaces unsaved local edits. Copy the list JSON first to retain them.
designer.filter_rate: Please wait briefly before saving again.
designer.filter_unavailable: Join a world to edit its server settings.
designer.filter_config_large: The server filter exceeds 512 entries or 28 KiB. Reduce it in the server config first; the existing configuration is unchanged.
designer.filter_conflict: Server rules changed; your edits are retained. Merge your changes, review and save, or load the server version.
designer.filter_invalid: Invalid IDs, JSON or size limit. The original list was retained.
designer.filter_limit: The filter supports 512 entries. Nothing was added.
designer.filter_save_failed: Server save failed. Edits remain; read server settings to reconcile.
designer.filter_save_unknown: Save confirmation timed out; result unknown. Edits remain. Refresh to inspect server settings.
designer.filter_close_help: Filter edits are unsaved. Save to the server, discard or return to editing.
designer.filter_catalog_loading: Reading server products… You can keep editing the list.
designer.filter_catalog_wait: The product catalog is not ready. Refresh to retry; your list is retained.
designer.filter_effect: Draft allows: %s comb types · %s comb block types  |  %s list entries
designer.filter_preview_empty: No targets match the current rule. Check the allow list, products or search.
designer.filter_order_help: Rules apply by bee ID to combs and comb blocks. List order does not change random weights. Shift selects a range; drag to organize. Save to apply.
designer.filter_merged: Local additions and removals merged with the latest server list. Review and save.
designer.tutorial_open_editor: Open the bee editor before starting the guided tour.
designer.catalog_tour_dismiss: Dismiss this introduction; reopen the tour from Settings → Shortcuts.
designer.catalog_select_help: Select bees for export. Select every search result or use source filters for modpack and editor bees.
designer.catalog_welcome: Start with New bee or a catalog entry. Use Import project for files and Other modpacks for local installations. Quick tour walks through the controls.
designer.catalog_select_all_help: Select every search result, including bees outside the current view. The selection updates after all pages load.
designer.catalog_quick_help: Select by source: modpack additions, editor additions or edits, unapplied drafts, or the current view.
designer.tutorial.live.workspace.title: Your main tools are here
designer.tutorial.live.workspace.body: New bee starts a project; Import project reads a file; Drafts continues local work. Refresh is beside search; Manage holds history and the recycle bin. Reopen this tour from Settings → Shortcuts after finishing or skipping it.
designer.tutorial.live.migration.title: Browse and move between modpacks
designer.tutorial.live.migration.body: Other modpacks browses local instances without changing them. Select bees, all results or source groups and export a collection. Import it in the target pack, resolve ID conflicts, check dependencies and apply the batch.
designer.tutorial.live.jei.title: Drag materials from JEI
designer.tutorial.live.jei.body: Drag from JEI to a highlighted slot to add or replace a material. Only the configuration is copied. The coach hides during the drag and the JEI preview stays in front. Click a slot to open the picker instead.
designer.tutorial.live_subpage: You can use this page. Finish or go back through its controls before continuing the tour.
designer.tutorial.live.select.title: Select a bee
designer.tutorial.live.select.body: Search names, IDs or Pinyin and open an ordinary bee, or create a draft. The tour does not create or apply content.
designer.tutorial.live.appearance.title: Name and appearance
designer.tutorial.live.appearance.body: Type into the highlighted name field. Adjust model, colors and size below; the preview follows your edits.
designer.tutorial.live.attributes.title: Flowers and attributes
designer.tutorial.live.attributes.body: Choose a flower, then genes, tolerances and traits. Select genes directly; narrow windows wrap them. Other choices use dropdowns and states use switches.
designer.tutorial.live.acquisition.title: Add acquisition
designer.tutorial.live.acquisition.body: Add crafting, breeding, conversion or bottling. The highlighted machine action selects installed machines and edits inputs and bee eggs.
designer.tutorial.live.outputs.title: Configure outputs
designer.tutorial.live.outputs.body: Add direct production or comb centrifuging, or edit individual recipes. Type amounts and chances and choose materials by icon.
designer.tutorial.live.review.title: Validate before applying
designer.tutorial.live.review.body: Use the highlighted validation action. Issues link to their fields. Applying to the world changes game resources.
designer.tutorial.live.portable.title: Export and share
designer.tutorial.live.portable.body: Portable collections move between modpacks. Local datapacks and KubeJS exports are for packaging. Select a format and attribution.
designer.tutorial.live.files.title: Inspect generated files
designer.tutorial.live.files.body: This expanded list shows generated content. Open a read-only preview and switch with previous/next or the file list.
designer.tutorial.live.deliver.title: Apply or export your finished bee here
designer.tutorial.live.deliver.body: Validate above and fix any issues first. Apply to World updates this world; Export Locally creates files to install or share. Got it ends the tour and leaves these actions in view. You confirm the action.
designer.tutorial.live.deliver.no_permis: You do not have permission to apply to this world. Validate and fix issues, then use Export Locally to save files for a server administrator. Got it only ends the tour and keeps your edits.
productivebeesgenesis.configuration.bee_: Third tint in #RRGGBB format. Leave blank to follow the primary color; its appearance depends on the selected PB model.
Bee size while carrying nectar, from 0 to 10. Zero follows the base size.
Enable the PB model's glow layer. Visible results depend on the model and texture.
Extra PB attack effect: none, fire (ignite for 200 ticks), or lava (place lava at the target).
Damage message IDs to ignore, such as inFire or fall. An empty list adds no immunities.
PB render-transform name. Use none for the default; this changes presentation, not AI or combat.
Flower block registry ID, or blank to leave this flower source unset. Use one active flower source.
